enchantments.tooltip: +1 Enhancement Bonus: +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Curse of Repulsiveness: Passive -1 Penalty to Charisma. (The minimum level required to equip this item is lower than normal due to this curse.)
Melee Alacrity 10%: Gain 10% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Tchurvul's Touch: This weapon causes running sores that make the target of its blows extremely irritable. There is a small chance that creatures lose -1 Charisma when hit by this weapon.
